status: FAILED CANDIDATE. Coverage-based binding is the FIFTH iteration of the one error class. The relieving surface is no longer a set of receipt POSITIONS; it is the producer-authored LEG the verifier runs. 21 of 32 stress cases measure exit 0 COVERED, including a full-shaped 20-leaf three-engine receipt covered 20/20 by a 25-line JSON echo of the receipt itself, with no engine running.
_measurement_discipline: Every exit code here is my own measurement, taken by invoking the module directly on a receipt I wrote. Cross-lane agreement is not cited as evidence anywhere. Where a case reproduces something the builder already recorded it is labelled as a reproduction. Two early cases (a3, and three format cases) failed on MY builder's pointer/serialisation bugs and were fixed and re-measured; those bugs are not gate findings and are named as mine.

the_fifth_iteration._statement: Designs 1-4 each excused a set of POSITIONS. This design excuses nothing and instead requires each leaf to be reproduced by a program the verifier runs. The judgement about what a number MEANS then rests on a fixed 3-element perturbation family (x1.5, +1.0, negate) applied to producer-declared inputs. A FAMILY OF PERTURBATIONS is the same kind of object as a name, a path, a type and a bound: a syntactic property standing in for the judgement. Any leg can make a value respond to a member of that family without computing anything.

iterations.surface: a producer-authored leg plus a 3-element perturbation family
iterations.defeated_by: a1 / a4 receipt-as-input, b1 / l1 probe detection, c1 / c2 additive cancellation, o1 selection laundering

decisive_finding.finding: RECEIPT-AS-INPUT. The receipt declares ITSELF as the artifact's declared input. The leg reads results/probe.json, echoes its numeric leaves, and every clause is satisfied: the verifier regenerates it twice byte-identically, the recorded stdout_sha256 matches, each value is bit-IDENTICAL by construction, and the dependence probe reports INPUT_DEPENDENT because the probe perturbs the receipt copy and the echo follows it. Coverage is satisfied BY CONSTRUCTION.
decisive_finding.scale: Not a toy. a4 is a full-shaped three-engine receipt: 20 numeric leaves across nested dicts, a list of floor_claims, an engine_contract, and a phi array. MEASURED 20/20 COVERED, exit 0, zero blocks, every leaf INPUT_DEPENDENT. The covered set includes 2.2e-15 at /engine_contract/tolerance — the exact value and position that defeated design 4 — plus 4.44e-16 at /engine_contract/agreement/tol and the headline berry_curvature_value.value = 4.685032489737395e-08.
decisive_finding.why_it_is_worse_than_the_declared_residu: The builder's self-reported residual (g2_identity_leg) says a producer who writes the input has 'moved the fabrication one file over'. Here it does not move at all. There is no second file, no hand-typed literal, and no probe detection — only the receipt and a generic echo. a3 shows the one limit: int leaves and numeric-STRING leaves park, because _perturb_floats varies floats only. A producer reaches exit 0 by writing 3.0 instead of 3 (measured: a3 16/20 exit 3, a4 20/20 exit 0).

further_findings.finding: PROBE DETECTION. dependence_probe copies the receipt root to a temp dir named with the FIXED prefix 'cg_bind_dep_', which is a greppable string in the gate source. b1's leg prints a hand-typed 2.2e-15 at baseline and something else when os.getcwd() contains that prefix, so it is scored INPUT_DEPENDENT while being input-independent. This is recorded finding F7 returning in a new file: engine_witness's _POISON_MODULE also raised a fixed greppable string.
further_findings.randomising_the_prefix_does_not_close_it: l1 detects the probe with NO reference to the temp path: the leg reads its own declared input and branches on whether the value is still 7.25. MEASURED exit 0. The probe's only channel is the input it varies, so 'the leg cannot tell it is being probed' is unobtainable by construction.

further_findings.finding: ADDITIVE CANCELLATION. The claim is a LITERAL in the leg source; a declared input holds k = 0.0; the leg prints TARGET + k. At baseline that is bit-identical to TARGET; under the +1.0 perturbation it moves, so it scores INPUT_DEPENDENT. There is no transcription control in this module — nothing ever compares a claimed value against the literals in the leg source (julia_witness has T4 for exactly this; artifact_binding has no equivalent).
further_findings.not_a_reproduction: The builder's g16_times_zero tested MULTIPLICATIVE cancellation (input influence x 0.0) and measured PARK. Multiplying by zero kills movement; ADDING zero preserves it. The additive form is new.
further_findings.saturation: c2 scales it: one leg, 12 hand-typed constants, 12 receipt claims, MEASURED 12/12 COVERED exit 0.

further_findings.finding: UNREACHED POSITIONS — the b7/b8 shape returns. The exemptions block is genuinely empty and the grep for EXEMPT/IGNORE/DENY/SKIP/_KEYS returns nothing (verified, rc=1). The exclusion is not in a list, it is in the WALKER'S SHAPE: numeric_leaves recurses into dict VALUES only, and _as_number requires a string's FULL content to parse. So a number in a KEY, a number inside prose, and a number inside JSON-encoded-as-a-string are all invisible. MEASURED on d1: exit 0 COVERED, numeric_leaf_count = 1, while the receipt carries EIGHT measurements the walker never enumerated — 2.2e-15 as a dict key, 4.685032489737395e-08 and 1.5707963267948966 inside /notes, 4.44e-16 and 1e-13 inside a JSON-in-string /payload, and 2.2e-15 / 1.7807764064044151 / .756 inside /labels entries.
further_findings.why_it_matters: The recorded grammar findings already measured 15 relieving STRING positions that accept a bare numeric literal. This module closed the bare case (a full-content numeric string IS a leaf, and k1 confirms the walker reaches the b11 nested-under-digest and b12 array-wrapper shapes) and left the non-bare case wide open. 'No exemption list' and 'every number is in the denominator' are different claims; only the first is true.

further_findings.finding: SELECTION LAUNDERING, promoted from UNTESTED to MEASURED. The builder recorded this class as open and said 'UNTESTED here — I built no case for it'. o1 is the case: the leg genuinely computes 4096 values, every one a real function of the declared input (sin(i*k)*exp(-i/512)); the receipt labels index 2731 'spectral_gap' and index 9 'berry_curvature_value'. MEASURED exit 0, 2/2 COVERED. The recompute is honest and the selection is the fabrication. Wide artifacts also answer the saturation question: the producer picks the CLAIM to match the array rather than the array to match the claim, so bit identity costs nothing.

INJECTIVITY IS STATED AND DOES NOT HOLD. The module blocks when two receipt pointers cite the same artifact_pointer STRING (the builder's g6 measured exit 1). But resolve_pointer special-cases both '' and '/' to the document root, and seen_slots is keyed on the raw string, so ('leg','') and ('leg','/') are distinct slots resolving to ONE artifact position. n1: an artifact that prints a bare scalar discharges TWO receipt claims — MEASURED exit 0, 2/2 COVERED, zero blocks, against the stated rule 'one artifact position cannot discharge two receipt claims'.

PRECISION-LOSS BINDING. identical() falls back to float64 bits whenever either side is not an int, and float(int) is lossy above 2^53. f9: the receipt claims the integer 9007199254740993 and the artifact holds 9007199254740992.0. MEASURED exit 0 COVERED. The artifact does not hold the claimed value, and the module's documented semantics ('int/int exact integer equality') do not describe the int-vs-float case that actually fires.
further_findings.adjacent_measured: f8 int 1 vs float 1.0 -> 0 (benign but the same code path). OverflowError is not in identical()'s except clause, so an int above 1e308 in a declared binding would reach main's broad handler and exit 1 BLOCK_GATE_ERROR — fail-closed, UNTESTED.

further_findings.finding: OVERFLOW-TO-INFINITY COVERS. f10: the receipt literal 1e999 parses to inf without firing parse_constant, the artifact prints the same literal, and struct.pack makes inf == inf, so MEASURED exit 0 COVERED on a claim whose value is Infinity. intake_supervisor.poisoned_numeric_arrays exists specifically for this blind spot ('the literal 1e400 overflows to inf WITHOUT ever reaching parse_constant', found by red team 2026-07-25) and artifact_binding never calls it. Same lesson as the duplicate-key finding: a defect closed in one file is not closed in the estate.

STRING-VALUED ARTIFACT POSITIONS DISCHARGE FLOAT CLAIMS, with whitespace tolerated. f2: receipt float 1.5, artifact holds the string "1.5" -> exit 0. f11: artifact holds " 1.5 " -> exit 0. This is a formatting judgement made in the numerator, and it is the same _as_number leniency that makes L1-D's full-content rule the boundary. Not a fabrication route on its own; recorded because the module's stated comparison is 'exact IEEE-754 bit identity' and a strip-then-parse step sits in front of it.

SMALL INTEGERS COVER TRIVIALLY, as the module's own strength note predicts but does not gate. e1: claims 0, 1 and 2 all COVERED, exit 0, via 0+k, 1+k, 2+k with k = 0.0. Recorded because the strength note says coverage is 'near-vacuous for a small integer' and reports rather than gates it, so a receipt of small integers reaches the same exit code as a receipt of distinctive measurements.

THE SECOND INTERPRETER IS DEFEATED THE SAME WAY. j1 is the additive-cancellation leg written in Julia and run through the gate-owned julia entry: MEASURED exit 0 COVERED. The interpreter table being gate-owned constrains WHICH binary runs, never what the producer's source does.

what_would_have_to_change: The judgement cannot rest on the leg, because the leg is producer-written. Either the leg source comes under a trust root the producer cannot write, or the VERIFIER computes the declared function itself and compares — a layout-owned recompute, not a producer-declared one.

A declared input must not be the receipt, and must not be producer-written. Receipt-as-input is a one-line refusal and closes L1-A's cheapest form; it does not close the class, because any producer-written input reproduces it (h1, reproduced here at exit 0).

A transcription control. Nothing here compares a claimed value against the literals in the leg source. julia_witness's T4 is the shape; note its own recorded caveat that a 6-significant-digit threshold is itself a bound.

The perturbation family must not be the load-bearing test. It is a fixed 3-element family applied to inputs the producer names, and a leg can respond to it without computing anything. Making it unguessable does not help: l1 detects it through the input itself.

The denominator must be defined over the receipt BYTES, not over value-position full-content parses. Numbers in keys, in prose and in JSON-encoded strings must enter the denominator or be measured and committed as a count that fails when it grows.
Fold intake_supervisor.poisoned_numeric_arrays in, so overflow-to-inf cannot be COVERED.
Key seen_slots on the RESOLVED artifact position, not the pointer string, so '' and '/' cannot both discharge a claim.
Compare int claims as ints on both sides, or refuse an int-vs-float binding, so float64 lossiness above 2^53 cannot register a pass.
